Welcome to the website for **Data Analysis and Information Extraction**, taught in the first semester of the 2026-2027 academic year at CUNEF Universidad. Here you will find the materials and labs that we will use during the course. This page will be updated frequently throughout the semester, so get into the habit of checking it often.
